definition: to prepare food by heating it
example: I cook dinner for my family every evening.
example_ru: Я готовлю ужин для своей семьи каждый вечер.

definition: to take liquid into your mouth and swallow it
example: I drink mineral water every day.
example_ru: Я пью минеральную воду каждый день.

definition: to control a car or other vehicle
example: I learned to drive two years ago.
example_ru: Я научился водить машину два года назад.

definition: to put food in your mouth and swallow it
example: I don't want to eat fast food for dinner.
example_ru: Я не хочу есть фастфуд на ужин.

definition: to move or travel to a place
example: We go to the cinema every month.
example_ru: Мы ходим в кино каждый месяц.

definition: to own or possess something
example: We don't have children but we have a dog.
example_ru: У нас нет детей, но у нас есть собака.

definition: to enjoy something
example: I like animals so I have a cat, a dog, and a rabbit at home.
example_ru: Я люблю животных, поэтому у меня дома есть кошка, собака и кролик.

definition: to pay attention to sound
example: I listen to music on my iPod.
example_ru: Я слушаю музыку на своем айподе.

definition: to have your home somewhere
example: I live in a flat with my sister.
example_ru: Я живу в квартире со своей сестрой.

definition: to require something because it is essential
example: In the US you need ID when you buy a drink.
example_ru: В США тебе нужно удостоверение личности, когда ты покупаешь напиток.

definition: to take part in a game or play a musical instrument
example: You play the guitar really well.
example_ru: Ты действительно хорошо играешь на гитаре.

definition: to look at words and understand them
example: I read a newspaper on the train every morning.
example_ru: Я читаю газету в поезде каждое утро.

definition: to speak words
example: You're late - say sorry to your teacher.
example_ru: Ты опоздал - извинись перед учителем.

definition: to talk to someone
example: British and American people speak the same language.
example_ru: Британцы и американцы говорят на одном языке.

definition: to spend time learning about a subject
example: I want to study economics at university.
example_ru: Я хочу изучать экономику в университете.

definition: to move something or someone from one place to another
example: I take an umbrella in my school bag every day.
example_ru: Я каждый день беру зонт в школьной сумке.

definition: to have a wish for something
example: I want a new car - a BMW!
example_ru: Я хочу новую машину - BMW!

definition: to look at something for a period of time
example: I watch TV on Saturday evenings.
example_ru: Я смотрю телевизор по субботам вечером.

definition: to have clothes on your body
example: Do you wear glasses for reading?
example_ru: Ты носишь очки для чтения?

definition: to do a job
example: I work in an office in the town centre.
example_ru: Я работаю в офисе в центре города.

definition: a person whose job is to keep financial records
example: My brother is an accountant.
example_ru: Мой брат — бухгалтер.

definition: a person who performs in plays or films
example: David is an actor.
example_ru: Дэвид — актер.

definition: a person who manages the work of a company
example: Karen is an administrator.
example_ru: Карен — администратор.

definition: a person who designs buildings
example: Norman Foster is an architect.
example_ru: Норман Фостер — архитектор.

definition: a person who is in charge of a bank
example: I want to be a bank manager and make lots of money.
example_ru: Я хочу быть управляющим банка и зарабатывать много денег.

definition: a person whose job is to build houses
example: Carl is a builder and he works very hard.
example_ru: Карл — строитель, и он очень много работает.

definition: a professional cook
example: Marco is a chef in an Italian restaurant.
example_ru: Марко — шеф-повар в итальянском ресторане.

definition: a person whose job is to clean
example: I need to find a cleaner.
example_ru: Мне нужно найти уборщика.

definition: a person who prepares and cooks food
example: Julie is a cook at the school.
example_ru: Джули — повар в школе.

definition: a person whose job is to take care of people's teeth
example: I want to see a dentist about my bad tooth.
example_ru: Я хочу показаться стоматологу насчет больного зуба.

definition: a person whose job is to help sick people
example: I don't feel well. I need to see a doctor.
example_ru: Я плохо себя чувствую. Мне нужно к врачу.

definition: a person who designs or builds machines or structures
example: We need an engineer to help with this project.
example_ru: Нам нужен инженер, чтобы помочь с этим проектом.

definition: a person who works in a factory
example: My uncle is a factory worker in a biscuit factory.
example_ru: Мой дядя — заводской рабочий на фабрике печенья.

definition: a person who serves passengers on a plane
example: She travels a lot. We think she's a flight attendant.
example_ru: Она много путешествует. Мы думаем, она стюардесса.

definition: a person who plays football
example: My friend is a footballer. He plays for Manchester United.
example_ru: Мой друг — футболист. Он играет за Манчестер Юнайтед.

definition: a person who shows people around a place
example: I work as a tour guide in London.
example_ru: Я работаю гидом в Лондоне.

definition: a person whose job is to cut people's hair
example: I'm a hairdresser. I cut people's hair.
example_ru: Я парикмахер. Я стригу людей.

definition: a person who writes for a newspaper or magazine
example: My dad is a journalist. He writes for a newspaper.
example_ru: Мой папа — журналист. Он пишет для газеты.

definition: a person whose job is to understand and use the law
example: My mother is a lawyer.
example_ru: Моя мама — юрист.

definition: a person who wears clothes to show them to others
example: Gisele Bundchen is a model.
example_ru: Жизель Бундхен — модель.

definition: a person who plays music
example: My brother is a famous musician.
example_ru: Мой брат — известный музыкант.

definition: a person whose job is to care for sick people
example: A nurse usually works in a hospital.
example_ru: Медсестра обычно работает в больнице.

definition: a person who flies a plane
example: A pilot flies planes.
example_ru: Пилот управляет самолетами.

definition: a person whose job is to catch criminals
example: There's a policewoman outside our house.
example_ru: Возле нашего дома есть женщина-полицейский.

definition: a person who works at the reception desk
example: A receptionist works at a hotel check-in desk.
example_ru: Администратор работает на стойке регистрации в отеле.

definition: a person who serves customers in a shop
example: A shop assistant serves customers in a shop.
example_ru: Продавец обслуживает клиентов в магазине.

definition: a member of an army
example: I'm a soldier. I work for the army.
example_ru: Я солдат. Я служу в армии.

definition: a person whose job is to drive a taxi
example: Taxi drivers work long hours.
example_ru: Водители такси работают долгие часы.

definition: a person whose job is to teach
example: I'm a teacher. I teach chemistry.
example_ru: Я учитель. Я преподаю химию.

definition: a doctor for animals
example: I'm a vet. I look after animals.
example_ru: Я ветеринар. Я забочусь о животных.

definition: a person who serves food in a restaurant
example: I am a waiter in a small café.
example_ru: Я официант в маленьком кафе.
